Title: Everyday science
Subject: Science
Class: Grade 7
Duration: 25 minutes
Instructions: Choose one answer for each question.

Q1. Which instrument measures temperature?
A. Ruler
B. Thermometer
C. Balance
ANS: B

Q2. Which material dissolves in water?
A. Sand
B. Gravel
C. Salt
ANS: C

Q3. What happens to liquid water when it freezes?
A. It becomes a solid.
B. It becomes a gas.
C. It stays liquid.
ANS: A
